key_insight: A general-purpose language-model agent combines materials databases, predictive models and reaction graphs to turn plain-language questions into testable synthesis plans.
engineering_relevance: The workflow connects candidate screening to practical experimental choices, including precursors, crucibles and atmospheres.
method: Equip the agent with Alexandria data, crystal-generation models and property predictors.
Use reaction energetics to screen candidates and assess synthesis routes.
Design experiments and challenge proposed materials against newly generated structures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports about 15 million density-functional calculations and a graph of 17.4 billion reactions, with unattended case studies producing proposals beyond a web-search-only baseline.
watch_item: The abstract describes computational proposals, not laboratory-confirmed synthesis or performance.
paper_title: Materials research with a general-purpose agent
